scope: 1M full reload and first 100K mixed-v1 append, local PostgreSQL/MinIO

layout.scope: raw-record writes and source/batch scans only

limitations: One of three baseline samples reuses the earlier same-image profiling control.
Fresh lakes do not imply cold OS caches; no concurrent pipeline timing workloads.
Validation/full references are excluded from both workload times.
No 10M, repeated-update/delete, smaller-memory or remote-S3 performance claim.
Python diagnostic timing is inconsistent; use call counts only.
Layout screen is raw writes/scans only; its container limit was 6 GiB, pipeline 10 GiB.
